square:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create a finished square 1:1 Jingle Bowl event campaign poster for Twisted Pin, a stylish bowling and cocktail venue in Plainfield, Illinois. Premium editorial Christmas illustration with subtle screenprint texture, exceptionally art-directed and readable, playful but sophisticated rather than a children's flyer. Deep almost-black indigo background #0E0A1F, warm ivory #F4EFE3 oversized ultra-condensed heavy sans serif type, a restrained mint accent #4EECC4, rich Christmas red Santa suit.
Composition: colossal perfectly legible stacked headline JINGLE / BOWL! occupies left and lower-middle; on the right a beautifully illustrated charismatic Santa in a red suit leans into frame holding a glossy dark evergreen bowling ball with exactly three finger holes, as if presenting a giant Christmas ornament. His white beard and hat sweep dynamically into negative space. Small gold star glints and one curling ribbon, no busy snowstorm. Strong silhouette, sophisticated illustrated lighting and detailed cloth/beard, striking at thumbnail size.
Exact text only: at top 'TWISTED PIN'; giant title 'JINGLE BOWL!'; short supporting line 'BOWL WITH SANTA'; generous bottom date block 'SUNDAY, DECEMBER 6' and small '2026 · PLAINFIELD, IL'. Clear typography with comfortable safe margins on every edge. No prices, no time, no pancakes, no food, no website URL, no fake logo design, no stock-image watermark. Avoid generic clip art, bubbly type, flat corporate vector style, photoreal venue backgrounds. This is campaign art, not a new venue logo. Supply a complete polished square poster at high resolution.
landscape: Edit this Jingle Bowl campaign poster into a finished wide landscape 1.91:1 composition suitable for a 1200x630 website social-share image and Google Business Profile event image. Preserve exactly the same Santa face, rich illustrated screenprint style, dark indigo/ivory/mint/red/gold palette, green bowling ball with three holes, and campaign identity. Recompose naturally, do not just crop or letterbox the square. Santa occupies right 40%, large bold condensed 'JINGLE BOWL!' on left, supporting 'BOWL WITH SANTA', venue 'TWISTED PIN', date 'SUNDAY, DECEMBER 6' and small '2026 · PLAINFIELD, IL'. All text perfectly readable inside a comfortable 6% safe margin. No other text, no prices or times, no food. Landscape poster, same campaign, no new logo.
